svg.title: Contribution activity as an oscilloscope trace
svg.desc: Oscilloscope-style trace of weekly GitHub contributions over the last year (square-root scale). 1211 contributions, 183 active days out of 369, longest streak 66 days, current streak 66 days, peak day 120 on 2026-09-11, mean 22.8 per week.
svg.text: src: github contribution calendar · redrawn daily by actions
